reader.requirement: At 85 a DISPLAY with no UPON phrase must send its data to the implementor's standard display device (WiseOwl: standard output, DOC-A.1-59), the same device a mnemonic for CONSOLE or SYSOUT names, and not to a device such as SYSERR.

edition-consulted.switches: END-DISPLAY and numeric-literal form gates only; not the device choice

reader.edition-search: BindDisplayUpon/MnemonicDevice and EmitDisplay grep clean of DialectLevel/Edition/ConstructRegistry/DialectBehavior: no UPON means ToStdErr=false and the sink is System.Console at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f13_01 covers no-UPON, SYSOUT and SYSERR; the probe adds CONSOLE, NO ADVANCING on the default device and an undeclared UPON mnemonic

probes.printed: stdout: NOUPON-1 ABC / CONSOLE ABC / NOUPON-2|TAIL ; stderr: ERR-LINE
probes.expected: no-UPON lines on the standard display device (stdout), CONSOLE the same device, SYSERR elsewhere

probes.printed: COBOL0817 DISPLAY UPON 'NO-SUCH-DEV': not a mnemonic-name declared in SPECIAL-NAMES
probes.expected: refused (§1985:VI.6.10.3 SR1 mnemonic-name-1 associated with a device in SPECIAL-NAMES)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.10.4 GR7  (6.10.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7

reader.notes: The bound DISPLAY carries ToStdErr only when UPON resolves to a SYSERR device row; otherwise the emitter's sink is System.Console, the documented standard display device. No edition arm on this path.

refuter.evidence: disp7r.cob at --std 85 (runs/disp7r-001): SPECIAL-NAMES SYSERR IS ERRDEV, SYSOUT IS OUTDEV; no-UPON DISPLAY in the main program and in a nested program (CALL "INNER") both on stdout, UPON OUTDEV on stdout, UPON ERRDEV on stderr; NO ADVANCING on the default device continues into the next no-UPON DISPLAY ('O4|O5') across an intervening stderr DISPLAY. AcceptDisplayEmitter.cs#EmitDisplay picks Console.Error only when BoundDisplay.ToStdErr, set only by BindDisplayUpon; no edition test on the device choice. cite: OK  §1985:VI.6.10.4 GR7  (6.10.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7.
